classification.difficultyReason: Find each linear argument's zero, identify the left and right gradients, and sketch the resulting V; the requested vertex and gradients explicitly guide the graph construction.

content.prompt: For each of the following, state the coordinates of the vertex and the gradients of the branches, and hence sketch the graph.

answer.worked:
$$2x=0\quad\text{at }x=0.$$
$$y=\begin{cases}-2x,&x<0,\\2x,&x\geq0.\end{cases}$$
The vertex is $(0,0)$; the left and right gradients are $-2$ and $2$.

spec.description: Upward V at origin with gradients plus and minus 2; no grid.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2x-4&=0\\2x&=4\\x&=2.\end{align*}$$
$$y=\begin{cases}-2x+4,&x<2,\\2x-4,&x\geq2.\end{cases}$$
The vertex is $(2,0)$; the branch gradients are $-2$ and $2$. The $y$-intercept is $4$.

spec.description: Upward V with vertex x=2, y-intercept 4 and branch gradients plus and minus 2.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}3x+6&=0\\3x&=-6\\x&=-2.\end{align*}$$
$$y=\begin{cases}-3x-6,&x<-2,\\3x+6,&x\geq-2.\end{cases}$$
The vertex is $(-2,0)$; the branch gradients are $-3$ and $3$. The $y$-intercept is $6$.

spec.description: Upward V with vertex x=-2, y-intercept 6 and branch gradients plus and minus 3.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{2}+2&=0\\\frac{x}{2}&=-2\\x&=-4.\end{align*}$$
$$y=\begin{cases}-\frac{x}{2}-2,&x<-4,\\\frac{x}{2}+2,&x\geq-4.\end{cases}$$
The vertex is $(-4,0)$; the branch gradients are $-\frac12$ and $\frac12$. The $y$-intercept is $2$.

spec.description: Upward V with vertex x=-4, y-intercept 2 and branch gradients plus and minus one half.
